sources.title: 9 Best 3B Local LLM Model (Open Source) - Sci Fi Logic
sources.snippet: StableLM Zephyr 3B The "StableLM Zephyr 3B" is a language model developed by Stability AI, designed for text generation tasks. It's an auto-regressive language model based on the transformer decoder architecture, with a total of 3 billion parameters.

sources.title: VibeThinker: 3B model reasons and codes at the level of flagship models
sources.snippet: Sina Weibo AI published VibeThinker-3B — a compact language model with just 3 billion parameters that matches flagship models DeepSeek V3.2 (671B), GLM-5 (744B), and Gemini 3 Pro on verifiable reasoning tasks including mathematics, coding, and STEM.
